sousTitre: Ask about your figures or how to use the app (“how do I…?”). The assistant reads your real data (within your rights) and the user guide.

reflexion: The assistant is reading your figures…
avertissement: AI-generated answers from your data: check important figures before deciding.
iaDesactivee: AI features are disabled for your account.

rapport.aide: Ready-to-present deck: real figures, editable charts and AI-written commentary.
rapport.echec: The presentation could not be generated.

voix.astuce: Tap the mic and dictate, e.g. “Sale to Boutique Exemple, ten Bacca mil 350, paid cash”. Tap the mic again to finish: the text appears in the input box — check it, then tap Send.
voix.microRefuse: Microphone blocked: allow it for this site in your browser.
voix.silence: I didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and speak clearly.
voix.erreur: Dictation failed (connection?). You can type your request.

fiche.remiseHorsSeuil: ⚠️ A {{pct}}% discount exceeds the allowed threshold ({{seuil}}%): only a manager or administrator can apply it.
fiche.motifRemiseRequis: Enter the reason for the discount.

bulle.deplacer: Open the AI assistant — hold and drag to move

encaissement.referenceObligatoire: Enter the cheque or transfer reference.
encaissement.depassement: The amount ({{montant}}) exceeds what is owed ({{du}}): only the amount owed is allocated.

client.doublons: Similar customers already exist: {{noms}}. Check it is not the same.

visite.aide: You can add photos from the round.
visite.tournee: It is linked to today's round.

titres.sortie: Issue to a sales rep to confirm
titres.demande_sortie: Stock request to send to the warehouse

ok.sortie: Issue saved: goods are in the rep's stock.
ok.transfert: Transfer sent: to be received by the destination warehouse.
ok.commande_livrer: Delivery saved: the sale is created and stock deducted.
ok.demande_sortie: Request sent to the stock manager: you will be notified as soon as it is processed.

stock.justificatif: Photo of the supplier delivery note
stock.justificatifObligatoire: Your company requires a supporting document: take a photo of the supplier note.
stock.lotObligatoire: Your company requires a batch number for each item.
stock.choisirMagasin: Choose the warehouse the goods leave from.
stock.aideLivraison: Correct the quantities actually delivered in case of shortage: the sale is created on these quantities.

delaiDepasse: The assistant is taking too long to answer. Check your connection, then try again with a shorter question.
